### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **34** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/system.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**6** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`  _(via getBookTree (sdk, the bare tail of client method meta.getBookTree, bound to GET /api/v1/meta/book/:name/tree), meta.getBookTree (sdk, the route ledger binds it to GET /api/v1/meta/book/:name/tree, selected by route anchor /meta/book/:name/tree))_
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`  _(via handleMetadataRequest (symbol, a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`  _(via TranslationDataSchema (symbol, a top-level const), globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema), metadataForms (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY), settingsCommon (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema))_
- `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx`  _(via /book/:name/tree (route, bridged from symbol createMetaBookTreeAnswer — its route source's handler names it), /meta/book/:name/tree (route, a path literal in a comment in appTranslationDataShape; a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`  _(via globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema), metadataForms (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY), settingsCommon (literal, a string literal in PER_APP_SETTINGS_PLATFORM_ONLY))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v14.mdx`  _(via /book/:name/tree (route, bridged from symbol createMetaBookTreeAnswer — its route source's handler names it), /meta/book/:name/tree (route, a path literal in a comment in appTranslationDataShape; a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via /book/:name/tree (route, bridged from symbol createMetaBookTreeAnswer — its route source's handler names it), /meta/book/:name/tree (route, a path literal in a comment in appTranslationDataShape; a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via globalActions (literal, a string literal in PlatformTranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationDataSchema; a string literal in TranslationItemSchema))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/system.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **7** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **55** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **159** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 96e7a4335c0aa611a706664da6df339f672ec1ab` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e39bcb2b433a12d81fade431f99ab14ca48f07d7` — the merge of head `525ae464723b8994fec778d41e303a0049573e84` into base `96e7a4335c0aa611a706664da6df339f672ec1ab`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e39bcb2b433a12d81fade431f99ab14ca48f07d7 && git checkout e39bcb2b433a12d81fade431f99ab14ca48f07d7
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 96e7a4335c0aa611a706664da6df339f672ec1ab 525ae464723b8994fec778d41e303a0049573e84 && git checkout -B drift-repro 96e7a4335c0aa611a706664da6df339f672ec1ab && git merge --no-ff 525ae464723b8994fec778d41e303a0049573e84

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 96e7a4335c0aa611a706664da6df339f672ec1ab
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 96e7a4335c0aa611a706664da6df339f672ec1ab` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1f17d1834b91871decdcee2631dd145b9c979773`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/book.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts + packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts, packages/rest/src/index.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts, scripts/fixtures/i18n-walk-parity/every-group.stack.json, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/TranslationPreview.tsx, ui/apps/console/src/pages/use-book-data.ts, ui/apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts, .changeset/26690-translation-books.md

Inputs read: card #26690 (body, triage 6443918209, claim 6446870967, os-dev-report 6449088056), PR #26819 body and file list, the net diff `origin/main...1f17d1834` (30 files), and the check-runs on the head. Check-runs at review time: 39 runs, 16 `success`, 5 `skipped` (opt-in lanes), 18 `in_progress` (Build Core/UI Deps/Docs, Test Core 1-8, Type Check workspace/debt/consumer, Lint scoped/repo/PM/CI gates), 0 `failure`. Those conclusions are the gate verdicts; nothing was built or run here. The seat's landing waits for the required jobs to conclude `success` (review-checklist: Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check pinned to this head).

The rest of the diff (docs under `content/docs/**`, the showcase bundle, liveness, api-surface/authorable-surface/export-origins, the console and app-shell tests, the runtime parity test) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; it was read to judge the hits, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set:
- `books` opens on all three doors through the shared `appTranslationDataShape()` — `TranslationDataSchema`, `PlatformTranslationDataSchema`, `TranslationItemSchema` — right: one hunk, three faces, the way `reports` (#25826) and `positions`/`permissions` (#25701) landed. The spec test parses the same bundle at all three.
- Strict at both levels (`strictObject` with `surface` / `history` / `aliases`, the `pages` and `permissions` idiom); `groups.KEY.label` is REQUIRED while the book's `label` / `description` are optional — right: a group entry with no label overlays nothing, and the extractor demands it (`pushEntry`) for the same reason. Unknown keys refuse with `unrecognized_keys` (pinned).
- Aliases `name`/`title` → `label`, `sections`/`chapters`/`toc` → `groups`, nested `name`/`title` → `label`, and the singular `book` → `books` on all three top-level alias maps — right; every target exists on the shape (the alias-integrity rule), and `book` collides with no sibling key.
- The `settings` refusal prose and the shape docblocks move fourteen → fifteen (sixteen on the platform face), and `books` sits between `permissions` and `metadataForms` both in the shape and in the "in the order it declares them" list — right.
- `BookSchema`: no accept-set change. The retired `translations` key still refuses (`retiredKey`, pinned); only its prescription moved from "delete, use doc.translations" to "delete and move the strings to `books.NAME.*`" — right, the old text would be false after this diff.

Public surface:
- `@objectstack/spec`: `translateBook`, `BookLike`, `BookGroupLike` exported; api-surface and export-origins regenerated to match — right (the `ReportLike` precedent).
- `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES` gains `book` by derivation from `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS` — right; `isTranslatableMetaType` in the rest gate reads the derived set, so `GET /meta/book` list and item translate with no further wiring (parity test pins both transports).
- `@objectstack/rest`: `MetaBookTreeSources` gains the REQUIRED member `resolveI18nService()` (via `Pick<MetaListTranslationSources, 'resolveI18nService'>`); the type is exported from `packages/rest/src/index.ts` — judged in ③, right as shipped.
- `@objectstack/runtime`: the dispatcher's book-tree route spreads `metaTranslationSources(...)` (which supplies `resolveI18nService`, `resolveProtocol`, `requestLocale`) after `metaItemReadGateSources`; the earlier explicit `requestLocale` line is subsumed, later spread wins — right. The gate then overrides `resolveProtocol` with `async () => undefined` because `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` has no `book` row — right, no protocol call is wasted.
- `@objectstack/cli`: `walkBooks` emits `books.NAME.label` / `.description` (`pushOptional`, optional on `BookSchema`) and `books.NAME.groups.KEY.label` (`pushEntry`, required) with source `book`; coverage maps `book` → `i18n/missing-book` with noun and surface rows — right. The walk-parity fixture authors a `books[]` member so `check-i18n-walk-parity`'s declared == walked holds without a ledger entry — right.
- Liveness: `translation/books` and its children seeded `live` with the resolver and the two rest readers as evidence; state counts 38 → 41 — right.
- `ui/packages/app-shell` `TranslationPreview.tsx`: `CATEGORY_DEFS satisfies Record<keyof TranslationDataSchema.shape, …>` — the `books` row and its en/zh strings are a NECESSARY consequence of the schema change, not scope creep (the build reds without them). `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so no changeset is owed for it.
- Console: no code change, correctly. `use-book-data.ts` reads `client.meta.getItems('book')` and `book-nav.ts` renders `book.label` / `group.label` as served, so the translated list IS the sidebar; the console test pins bundle → served book → sidebar.
- Generated docs (`content/docs/references/system/book.mdx`, `translation.mdx`, `api/protocol.mdx`) match the new `.describe()` text byte-for-byte in the hunks read — right, regenerated not hand-edited.

Nothing derived is judged wrong.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/26690-translation-books.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/rest` minor, `@objectstack/runtime` minor, `@objectstack/cli` minor. Right:
- `Metadata-protocol: added` (new authorable keys `books.NAME.label` / `.description` / `.groups.KEY.label`) takes at least `minor` on the package the diff moves — spec. Right.
- rest/runtime/cli carry new behaviour (a translated tree, a new port member, new extract keys and a new coverage bucket) — `minor` is the honest level; none is a bug fix.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` and the console are private; `examples/app-showcase` is private; `@objectstack/lint` is untouched. No changeset missing.
- Both declaration lines are present and identical in the PR body and the changeset body; no BREAKING banner is claimed, so no ADR-0087 marker is owed.

Clause-②: yes (widening). Right — nothing an author could write before is refused now; the only prose that changed on a refusal (the retired `translations` tombstone) still refuses the same key.
Metadata-protocol: added. Right — a new key family, no key removed, no default or meaning changed.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **`MetaBookTreeSources.resolveI18nService` required or optional?** — Answer: **A, required, as shipped.** Weighed by public-surface cost: the interface IS exported (`export type { MetaBookTreeSources }` in `packages/rest/src/index.ts`) and it is a port a transport CONSTRUCTS (an object literal handed to `createMetaBookTreeAnswer`), so a required member added to it is a compile-time break for any external transport on upgrade. Three things outweigh that: (a) the port's own contract is "each transport supplies only its I/O" and every sibling read already requires `resolveI18nService` on `MetaListTranslationSources`; the book tree inheriting that requirement is the port becoming consistent, not a new kind of demand; (b) an optional member converts a forgotten line into a tree served in the authoring language with nothing logged — the silent-degradation shape this repo's rules reject; a type error is the loud, migratable form; (c) no external implementer exists in-tree (rest-server, meta-item-read-routes, runtime meta.ts are the only three) and the changeset names the member for anyone outside. Level: the port is not an authorable surface, so Clause-② is judged on the metadata face (widening), and the TS-level requirement ships under `minor` with the member named in the changeset body — adequate.
2. **Synthetic `Uncategorized` group stays English** — accepted as pre-existing (`resolveBookTree` hardcodes `label: 'Uncategorized'`; not an authored group, no bundle key). Not in this card's done-when (authored book label and group labels). Carrier note for a follow-up: a zh-CN reader with orphan docs still sees one English section title.
3. **Implicit per-package book resolves `books.PACKAGE_ID.label`** — an effect of translating whatever book the tree resolves; harmless, and arguably useful. No action.
4. **Pinned spine-node labels** (`groups[].pages[]` entries of the `{ doc, label }` / `{ href, label }` form) are not translated by `translateBook` — flagged here, not by the dev. `resolveBookTree` renders `node.label ?? d?.label`, so an authored node label already overrides the doc's own `doc.translations` label today; the gap is pre-existing in kind and outside the card's done-when. Escalated as a follow-up note for the seat, not a finding on this diff.
5. **`translation-target-unknown` has no `books` arm** (dev's class-c finding) — judged below in ④ as a should-fix; routing in the summary.
6. **`Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md, evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`** — a permitted form under pm-dispatch; the seat files the owed card and rewrites the line to `#N` before ACCEPT (review-checklist). A seat action, not a review finding.
7. **Check-runs** — 18 still `in_progress` on the head at review time, 0 red. The seat pins the required jobs' `conclusion: success` to `1f17d1834` before landing; this record does not pre-empt them.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`** — holds. Tried to break: an author writing `books.b.groups.g.title` is refused with the `label` alias (pinned); `books.b.icon` refused `unrecognized_keys` (pinned); the singular `book` is refused with a pointer at `books` on each door (pinned). The group `label` being required where siblings' top-level `label` is optional is the correct asymmetry: a book's title may be absent (the schema allows it), a group's section title cannot be. The prose counts and the declared-order list agree with the shape. No finding.

**`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`** — holds. `translateBook` follows `translateReport`'s skeleton: name guard, per-attribute `localeChain` × `pickData` lookup (so the BCP-47 ladder, the deployment default-locale rule and the declared `fallbackChain` apply unchanged — pinned), an empty-string translation treated as absent (sibling rule), the SAME REFERENCE when nothing moves (pinned for en-US and for no bundle), per-key fallback to the authored string (pinned), and no mutation (pinned). It takes `ResolveOptions` and ignores `packagedBase` — right, because `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` carries no `book` row (books are not org-overridable at the protocol), the `translateApp` precedent, so the gate's `resolveProtocol: async () => undefined` is consistent rather than a shortcut. A group without a string `key` passes through untouched; group order and every other group field ride through the spread. Registration in `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS` is the whole REST wiring (pinned via `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES.has('book')` and the runtime parity test on both transports). The description is translated on the list/item documents; `ResolvedBookSchema` carries no `description`, so the tree drops it — the tree's pre-existing shape, not a loss introduced here. No finding on the file.

**`packages/spec/src/system/book.zod.ts`** — holds. Prose only: the tombstone's prescription now names the bundle keys and `os i18n extract`, and the `label` describes name their keys; the old "the tree endpoint and the portal render label/description verbatim" sentence is removed because this diff makes it false. The retired key still refuses with `retiredKey` (pinned: the refusal text contains `books.<book>.groups.<group_key>.label`). The generated reference doc carries the same text. No finding.

**Cited code read, as one change with the rule:**
- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` `createMetaBookTreeAnswer` step 5: translation runs AFTER `audience.admitsBook(book)` on the stored book — right, a label is not an access input and the audience must be judged on what was authored. `served as typeof book` is safe: the gate already returned on an undefined book. The route (`meta-item-read-routes.ts`) and the dispatcher (`runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`) both supply `resolveI18nService`, and the parity test pins the zh-CN/en-US tree on both transports with the doc entry still localized by `doc.translations`. One observation, pre-existing and not introduced here: the doc collapse uses `sources.requestLocale()` with no i18n service while the book translation uses `requestLocale(i18n)`, so a deployment default-locale fallback can reach the book and not the docs; no change asked of this PR.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` / `i18n-coverage.ts`: the walk is keyed by `name` and `key`, never by position; the new cli test pins the key set, the optional/required split, that a bundle written at the extracted paths parses under `TranslationDataSchema`, and the `book` bucket. Holds.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts` (the dev's class-c): the rule resolves `objects`, `views`, `pages`, `globalActions`, `apps`, `dashboards`, `flows`, `picklists`, and — through `namedItemGroups` — `positions`, `permissions`, `reports`. There is no `books` arm, and the header's "deliberately does NOT check" ledger does not list it, so `books.crm_manaul.label` parses clean, lints clean, and `GET /meta/book` serves the authored string in silence. **Should-fix, not a must-fix:** (i) the schema accept-set is identical to every sibling named group — a record keyed by name — so no authorable key is refused or accepted differently by the lint's absence; (ii) `datasets` sits in the same unledgered state on `main` today, so this is not a hole unique to this diff; (iii) the claim's file surface excluded the lint and the dev stopped and reported as the dispatch ordered. Against it, and why it is owed promptly: the two most recent named groups (`positions`/`permissions` in #25701, `reports` in #25826) each landed their arm IN THE SAME PR as the group, and the rule's own header says an orphan key is "actively misleading", not inert. Routing: a one-commit patch round on this PR is small (one `namedItemGroups` row with `namesOf('books')`, plus a `groups.KEY` sub-leg against the book's declared group keys, plus a header line) and preferred; failing that, a filed card referenced from the PR before ACCEPT — ⛔ not a note.

Must-fix: none.
Should-fix: S1 — `translation-target-unknown` gains a `books.NAME` arm and a `books.NAME.groups.KEY` sub-leg (same-PR patch round preferred; else a filed follow-up card before ACCEPT).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-g5q3wk`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzfhobWEgUUrjz4rrbh`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4b8fb9a1b366c289bfa57251875f25336a1c3971`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/system/book.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts, packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts + packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts, packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts, packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts, packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/utils/spec-translations.ts, ui/apps/console/src/loadLanguage.test.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/TranslationPreview.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/adminPreviews.i18n-10862-s2.test.tsx, .changeset/26690-translation-books.md, .changeset/config.json

DELTA record over the full review at `1f17d1834` (PR comment 6449452917, VERDICT PASS, should-fix S1). It judges the one commit `1f17d183..4b8fb9a1` (`fix(lint,i18n): unknown doc-book translation keys are reported; the console loader knows books`, 6 files, +149/−4), which the seat's claim amendment 6449487635 asked for, and re-affirms or corrects each judgment of the full record at the new head. Everything the full record found on the 29 files the delta does not touch stands unchanged; only what is named below moves.

Inputs read: card #26690 (body; triage 6443918209, claim 6446870967, os-dev-report 6449088056, claim amendment 6449487635), PR #26819 body, its 35-file list and the net diff against `main` plus the delta diff `1f17d183..4b8fb9a1`, and the check-runs on `4b8fb9a1` at 2026-10-27T18:18Z: 31 runs, 7 `success` (Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, Auto Label, filter), 5 `skipped` (opt-in lanes), 19 `in_progress` (Build Core/UI Deps/Docs, Plan Test Core shards, every Lint and Type Check job, Spec property liveness, Check Changeset, Flag docs), 0 `failure`. The Test Core shards and the UI test lane had not spawned yet. Those conclusions are the gate verdicts; nothing was built, run or re-run here. The seat pins the required jobs' `conclusion: success` to `4b8fb9a1` before landing; this record does not pre-empt them.

### ① Derived judgments

**S1 is closed.** The full record asked for a `books.NAME` arm, a `books.NAME.groups.KEY` sub-leg and a header line; the delta carries all three, with a fourth thing (the implicit-book admission) judged below.

Accept-set (what `os lint` now refuses, relative to `main`):
- `books.NAME` keyed to no declared book → `translation-target-unknown`, `error`, `where` = `locale "L" · book "NAME"`, nearest-name hint through the shared `suggest` → right; the `reports` arm's exact shape (`namedItemGroups`), and the `concat` disposition it relies on is real: `COMPOSE_KEY_DISPOSITIONS.books === 'concat'` (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`), so `artifactProvidedRecords(stack, 'books')` reading a sibling package's `manifest.books` is the right universe (pinned by the sibling-package test).
